name: staff-email-login-verification
title: Complete staff email invitation and login verification flow
description: Send staff login credentials only after account scope and role setup succeeds, then verify and activate the staff account after the first successful password login.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Initial passwords are included only in the invitation email body and never in URLs, audit metadata, or GraphQL responses. No GitHub status checks or pull-request workflow runs were available for the direct main commits, so focused Vitest and live SMTP delivery were not executed in this session.
